method.ego_source: Read-only inspection of installed MORAI 26.R1.H3 TF publisher; different ego and camera-local Euler construction. Vendor implementation not redistributed.
method.shared_lens: focal scale, cx, cy, k1, k2; soft-L1 bounded fit; fixed mounts and ride height; no learned model
method.training_edges: physical edge ID modulo 3 != 0, shared across views; table includes all matched edges. Excluded captures were used for candidate selection, not a blind final test.
method.measurement: offline installed-map paint boundaries matched to image gradients; identical observations compared across variants; runtime ground estimator uses only camera images and ego pose, not map or slot GT
method.seam_metric: absolute difference along projected paint-edge normal, in metres; correlated automatic matches, not independent surveyed 2D parking error
method.runtime_ground: bidirectional sparse optical flow in BEV overlaps; stereo triangulation; bounded robust plane fit; confidence gates; 1Hz; max age 2s and distance 1.5m
method.rejected_candidate: lens plus per-camera rotation fit reached bound and worsened older locations; no per-camera correction in deployed profile

limitations: Residual seams remain, especially new stationary capture (median 6.89 cm / p95 18.59 cm).
Two old v1-fit views regress relative to v1, but improve over initial static.
Five captured image sets; no blind new-location or moving-slope sequence qualification.
Ground plane cannot represent nonplanar road or vertical objects; repeated texture can produce false correspondences.
Ground support may fail and fall back to assumed level map / fixed ride height.
Live validation of new profile pending MORAI reconnection after ROS master stopped.
